subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a public reasoning display-format contract, and should its precedence be per-channel, per-agent/global, or both?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public config/default surface that affects multiple channels and existing reasoning visibility semantics, so automation should not choose the API shape.

options.title: Add Minimal Display-Format Contract
options.body: Preserve italic by default, support a small approved enum such as italic, code, spoiler, or blockquote, and document one precedence order across channel and agent defaults.

options.title: Limit To Telegram Presentation Policy
options.body: Defer shared agent config and resolve the readability concern through a Telegram-owned presentation or parse/text-mode direction alongside https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/10944.

options.title: Keep Fixed Formatting For Now
options.body: Keep the current fixed italic rendering and rely on `/reasoning` visibility controls until a broader reasoning presentation design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Display-Format Contract
recommendation.body: Preserve italic by default, support a small approved enum such as italic, code, spoiler, or blockquote, and document one precedence order across channel and agent defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history and prior-review signal on reasoning visibility/display and the config/API tradeoff here.
